snippet.title: Josephine – Δαχτυλίδι | Official Music Video (4K)
snippet.description:
🔔 Κάνε ΕΓΓΡΑΦΗ εδώ: http://bit.ly/HeavenMusicYouTube
📌 Βρες το «Δαχτυλίδι» εδώ: https://presave.heavenmusic.gr/t/dahtilidi

Στίχοι:
Ψάξε, ψάξε, με ρωτάνε,
Πού το πάμε, τόσο γιατί το τραβάμε,
Μα για απάντηση δεν έχω,
Τίποτα.

Με ρωτάνε πού το πάμε,
Αν καλά εμείς περνάμε,
Και γιατί δεν προχωράμε,
Στα επόμενα.

Μ’ αν θέλεις το καλό μου, καν’ το σωστό μωρό μου,
Δες, το χέρι μου δεν έχει δαχτυλίδι,
Λες σε εμένα η καρδιά σου πως ανήκει,
Μ’ αν δεν κάνεις το σωστό, 
Άλλο το μέλλον μου δεν θα το μοιραστώ.

Τώρα, που ‘ναι, που ‘ναι το,
Που ‘ναι το δαχτυλίδι,
Ψάξε, ψάξε δε, ψάξε δε,
Θα το βρεις.

Δε θυμάμαι να σου είπα,
Κι αν το είπα «είπα-ξείπα»,
Πως μου αρέσει στη ζωή μου,
Τ’ άγνωστο.

Λίγο ακόμα θα σ’ αφήσω,
Για να δω αν θα επενδύσω,
Ή αν αυτό θα ‘ναι το τέλος,
Το πικρό.

Τί άλλο να σου πω ακόμα,
Νιώθω πως είμαι ξένο σώμα,
Τι κι αν μου λες πως με λατρεύεις,
Ένα πράγμα μόνο σου ζητώ.

snippet.title: The Exorcist: Martyrs | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Darkness must be hunted. Mike Flanagan’s The Exorcist: Martyrs is only in theaters March 12.

Academy Award® nominee Scarlett Johansson fronts The Exorcist: Martyrs, an unsettling new chapter in one of the most storied titles in cinema history from genre auteur Mike Flanagan, the creator of acclaimed series The Haunting of Hill House, The Fall of the House of Usher, Midnight Mass, and the upcoming Carrie, as well as the films Doctor Sleep, The Life of Chuck, Hush and Gerald’s Game.

Thirteen years ago, New York City detective Julie Miller (Johansson) ended the terror reign of satanic serial killer Father Sunday. The case made her a hero, and she has thrown herself into her work ever since. Now a new killer scrawls her name in an altar boy’s blood on the walls of a church crypt, dragging her back into the darkness she believed she had buried with him. 

Aided by former prison chaplain Father William (Academy Award® nominee Chiwetel Ejiofor), who heard Father Sunday’s final confession, and sharp rookie detective Gina Restrepo (Sasha Calle, The Rip), Detective Miller will discover a filament linking a lineage of serial killers, from H.H. Holmes to the Zodiac, that could corrupt everything, and everyone, she loves with an evil that goes well beyond the mortal.

snippet.title: Season 5: A Grim Doctrine Launch Trailer | Overwatch
snippet.description:
Something truly wicked is being unleashed during Season 5: A Grim Doctrine.

The wait is over! Our newest Support Hero is here with the arrival of Doctrine. Freed from his volcanic prison by Doomfist himself, this sinister foe can manipulate life using his Eternal Scepter and mechanical drones, while also empowering each ability with his signature Infuse.

Break into Watchpoint: Grímsvötn - the Icelandic prison that once held Doctrine and Doomfist, and our first new Escort Map since Overwatch 2 launched. Battle your way through fire and ice as the final chapter in the Reign of Talon starts right here.

The Halloween mayhem continues this year with our newest event, Mystery Madness: Graveyard Games. You’ll start off as a random Hero and unlock random new powers each time you die. Complete chilling challenges to collect Offerings and help summon the next Hero into the madness.

Unlock haunting new cosmetics through the Season 5 Ultimate Battle Pass, Starter Pack, and in the Shop like Dokiwatch 2.0, our latest collaboration, and new Mythic skin for Wuyang and Mythic weapon skin for Lúcio.

If you thought you knew Sombra and Roadhog before, get ready to think again. Sombra is hacking her way into the Support role, while Roadhog changes things up with a revamped Scrap Gun and all-new Trash Compactor ability.

And that's just the beginning! Look out for Drives coming to Quick Play, Unvaulted Battle Passes, and so much more all season long.

Sink your teeth in when Season 5: A Grim Doctrine launches in-game TOMORROW at 11am PT.

snippet.title: Clayface | Final Trailer
snippet.description:
In four weeks, look fear in the face. #ClayfaceMovie - only in theaters October 23.

DC Studios’ “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the cult favorite villain from Gotham’s rogues gallery.

Matt Hagen’s meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss’s actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

The film also stars Naomi Ackie, David Dencik, Max Minghella and Eddie Marsan, as well as Nancy Carroll and Joshua James.

James Watkins directs from a screenplay by Mike Flanagan and Hossein Amini, story by Flanagan, based on characters from DC. The film is produced by Matt Reeves, Lynn Harris, James Gunn and Peter Safran, with Michael E. Uslan, Chantal Nong Vo, Lars P. Winther, Paul Ritchie, Rafi Crohn and Trevor Macy executive producing.

Watkins’ creative team includes director of photography Rob Hardy, production designer James Price, editor Jon Harris and costume designer Keith Madden. Music is by Volker Bertelmann.

DC Studios Presents a 6th & Idaho Production, a James Watkins Film, “Clayface.” The film will be distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures and released only in theaters in North America on October 23, 2026, and internationally beginning 21 October 2026.
